title: watch can hang standing open after its key reader has died
description:
2xk's stay-open view is entered when keyed && stayOnEnd. If the key reader died before the run ended, keys is set to nil but keyed stays true, so the standing select waits on a nil channel. The 'keyboard is gone' exit can never fire, and watch waits until a signal arrives. Fix: also require keys != nil.
